Kept in the repo so the deck opens offline and on networks that block CDNs.

| Folder | What | License |
|---|---|---|
| `katex/` | KaTeX 0.16.9 (`katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css`, `fonts/`) from npm | MIT (`katex/LICENSE`) |
| `fonts/` | Source Sans 3, latin subset, woff2 (400, 400 italic, 500, 600, 700) from `@fontsource/source-sans-3` 5.3.1 | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/LICENSE`) |
